description: Found by the ignored-test triage (2026-07-04, at d49562986). Three ignored port_misc_test.rs tests fail identically: test_macro_passing_assert_compiles, test_macro_failing_assert_compiles, multiple_test_blocks_compile. Each submit_root's a BARE NAME (test_one/test_bad/test_a) that only a top-level defmacro-produced `test`-block invocation produces. Diagnostic: 'function test_one/0 is not defined'. ROOT CAUSE (telemetry-traced): submit_root resolves only ALREADY-VISIBLE names, but a macro-PRODUCED top-level function name isn't visible until its item-level macro is expanded — and nothing triggers that expansion here (contrast the PASSING 00122_item_macro_compiler_ast.fz, which submits root 'main', an ordinary source fn whose BODY calls answer(), so callee-resolution naturally triggers the macro). These tests are ported from the DELETED legacy fz CLI's test_runner_test.rs, whose bespoke test-block discovery pass expanded item macros; fz2 has no such discovery (fz2.rs has no test subcommand). FIX: a root-name-discovery bridge — when submit_root names a bare top-level name that isn't yet defined, expand pending top-level ITEM macros (defmacro invocations at item scope) before/while resolving the root, mirroring what the deleted CLI runner did. All 3 tests would then pass as written. This is a MISSING CAPABILITY (item-macro-produced root discovery), not a test rewrite. Triage them together; one fix closes all 3. Low priority (macro-defined test DSL is a narrow surface). RELATED: the reusable-cons native-lowering pair (native.rs:3123 + Continuation extra_params ABI gap) is a SEPARATE finding, mapped to fz-go4.22 + the branch-join-bug family, not this ticket.

comments.text: LANDED at 6efa9fc16 (folded from wt/b5-43 737cddf47). Root cause: World::demand_function_scope only demanded ScopeCode on codes whose surface could STATICALLY match the wanted name — and a MacroCall form matched only RESERVED def-heads (source_definition_matches_function), so a user-defmacro-produced test-block (non-reserved head) was never a candidate home; ScopeCode never ran, and PublishFunctionSource deadlocked on the arm-less FunctionSourceStash wait. FIX: new item_macro_call_may_define treats any non-reserved-head opaque macro call as a candidate home (rules out only a reserved def-head naming a DIFFERENT function). Reuses the existing demand_function_scope -> CodeScoped -> ScopeCode -> apply_item_macro_call pull chain verbatim — no new job/fact/discovery pass (fold-aligned). All 3 tests (test_macro_passing_assert_compiles, test_macro_failing_assert_compiles, multiple_test_blocks_compile) un-ignored and passing as written. lib 1237/0/6 in-worktree, 1238/0/6 on the folded branch. Adversarial audit: SOUND, no blocker; false-home/disambiguation, termination, predicate correctness all cleared (candidate-home is a pure DEMAND trigger). Audit surfaced a bounded-but-real excess-work widening (whole-surface eager scoping on first unresolved global lookup, AND-semantics fan-out) -> fz-go4.53.

title: submit_root by bare name does not expand top-level item macros (macro-test-DSL tests never resolve)
